answer: Simultaneous ceremony stops one operator faking many. Each identity registers one orchard plot, one relic, and locks 70 credits. Each epoch at a random hour, each identity shows its relic live in its plot to a falcon auditor; a missing or duplicate relic burns both bonds. No operator can stand in 1,000 plots at once: 1,000 stand-ins at 50 cost 50,000, plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents attend once, keep the bond.
